_help: Rules for automatic publishing. The Scribe API returns every article on the account (no brand filter), so an APPROVED article is only published if its topic/title/keyword contains one of require_any_keyword, or its id is in allow_ids. Put ids you never want published in block_ids.
_auto_approve_help: Set to a number (e.g. 80) to also publish articles still 'in_review' whose Scribe quality_score is at least that value. null = only publish articles you approve manually.
